value: For each season find minimum positive driver total, include all tied drivers; associate actual constructors driven in same season; count each constructor-season once

value.expression: year>=2001 inclusive through latest available standings;2024 incomplete through round12

value.description: Latest available standings per year yields driver-season total; filter >0 and retain per-year minimum; join driver results in same year to actual constructors; count distinct seasons per constructor.

measure.countGrain.value: One constructor-year even if multiple minimum drivers or races

items.quote: which five constructors have had the most seasons
considering only drivers who scored points in a season
their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season

candidates.sql: WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT c.name,counts.seasons FROM counts JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) ORDER BY seasons DESC,c.constructor_id LIMIT 5
